user.title: Connect to the GeoTrack parent portal
user.description: The portal has no password. Signing in with a texted code is the easier route — it works entirely from this screen.

menu_options.login: Sign in with a code sent to my phone
menu_options.cookie: Paste a session cookie from my browser

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Enter the phone number registered with your school's GeoTrack account. The portal will send it a short login code.

data_description.host: The domain you sign in to, for example parent.geotrackny.com
data_description.phone: The number on the account. Digits only is fine.

code.title: Enter your login code
code.description: Enter the code the portal just sent to {phone}. It is only valid for a few minutes.

cookie.title: Paste a session cookie
cookie.description: Sign in at the portal in a desktop browser, open DevTools → Network, reload the page, click the GetVehicles request and copy the whole Cookie request header.

data_description.host: The domain you sign in to, for example parent.geotrackny.com
data_description.cookie: The full Cookie header, e.g. name1=value1; name2=value2

reauth_confirm.title: Session expired
reauth_confirm.description: The portal is no longer accepting the stored session. Sign in again to reconnect.

menu_options.login: Sign in with a code sent to my phone
menu_options.cookie: Paste a session cookie from my browser

error.invalid_auth: The portal rejected that session. Sign in again and copy a fresh cookie.
error.phone_not_found: That phone number is not linked to any GeoTrack account.
error.cannot_request_code: The portal would not send a login code. Check the number and try again.
error.invalid_code: That code was not accepted. It may have expired — go back and request a new one.
error.unexpected_response: The portal returned something unexpected. It may have changed its login pages.

abort.already_configured: This portal is already set up.

data.warning_minutes: Warn me this many minutes ahead

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the portal. The portal itself refreshes roughly every 20 seconds.
data_description.warning_minutes: The ETA is estimated from how long this bus actually takes between stops, measured over time. The portal itself publishes no arrival time.
